title: Fronting
description: Cross-Mint fronting links — operator-declared bridges that let one Mint resource exchange tokens for another via RFC 8693.
limitNotice: Showing first 100 links. Use filters to narrow.
empty: No fronting links yet. Create one to bridge two Mint resources.
mapSelectResources: Select source and target to map scopes.
noMappings: No scope mappings yet. Click "+ Add row" to start.
staleTargetTitle: stale: not in target.scopes — click to remove
selectTarget: select at least one target scope
frontsSubtitle: Outbound links — this resource is the source.
frontsEmpty: This Resource doesn't front any other Resource.
frontedBySubtitle: Inbound links — this resource is the target.
frontedByEmpty: This Resource isn't fronted by any other Resource.
mappingTargetRequired: Mapping for {{scope}} needs at least one target scope
sourceReadOnlyTitle: Source can't be changed on edit — delete and recreate to repoint.
targetReadOnlyTitle: Target can't be changed on edit — delete and recreate to repoint.
scopeMapHelp: Each row maps one source scope to one or more target scopes. Both sides come from the chosen Resources' scope lists.
validationOk: ✓ Validation OK — scope map references known scopes; no cycle would be introduced.
linkHelp: Each fronting link bridges one source resource to one target resource. The scope map's values must be scopes of the chosen target only — to bridge to a different target, create a separate fronting link.
validationHelp: Validate posts a dry-run for cycle and scope-membership checks before commit. On edit, only scope_map is patchable; re-pointing source/target requires delete + create.
deleteHelp: This removes the fronting-link row only. Both Resources stay.
graphEmpty: No fronting links yet. Switch to the List tab and click + New Fronting Link to create one.
graphScaleWarning: Graph view is best for small topologies — switch to the List tab for full data.
